sources.title: Pocket TTS - Learn AI
sources.snippet: Pocket TTS is a lightweight, open-source text-to-speech model developed by the French AI research laboratory Kyutai and released in September 2025. With approximately 100 million parameters in its distilled inference form, Pocket TTS achieves speech synthesis quality competitive with much larger models while running faster than real time on a standard laptop CPU without requiring a graphics ...

sources.title: Free CPU-Based Text-to-Speech Tool with Voice Cloning - Pocket TTS
sources.snippet: Pocket TTS is a free, lightweight text-to-speech tool that runs entirely on your CPU without requiring a GPU. This 100-million parameter model from Kyutai generates high-quality speech with voice cloning capabilities from just a single command.

sources.title: Pocket TTS Review: Kyutai's 100M CPU Voice Cloner (2026)
sources.snippet: Pocket TTS is Kyutai's new 100M-parameter text-to-speech model, released January 13, 2026 and trending on GitHub this week (2,609 stars gained, 7,379 total).
